fees.note: From the city's fee schedule (effective October 1, 2025; read 2026-10-13): an RV space with full hookups is $35 a day and can be booked only a week ahead, when one is free; water and 30-amp power $25; power only $20.  Campspot sells the water-and-power sites (waterfront and water view) at $25 and the power-only sites at $20 for October 2026, plus a $2 'Reservation Surcharge' once per stay on the water-and-power sites, and has the whole of 2027 closed to booking for now.

source: https://www.bradytx.us/955/Brady-Lake (Brady Lake fees effective October 1, 2025, Article 1.10, Ordinance 941: 'Per day - full hookups (50 amp electric, water, sewer) If available, only one week in advance. $35'; 'Per day (water, 30 amp electric only) $25'; 'RV with Electric only per day $20'), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/book/bradytx (Campspot's pricing for each RV site type, one night from 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-20, 2 adults; two nights from 2026-10-20 for the park's fees, which show the $2 surcharge once per stay on the waterfront and water view types and none on the electric-only type; 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 closed; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13

_patch.note_add: The city's fee schedule (effective October 1, 2025) also charges $25 a day for an RV space.
_patch.source_add: ; https://www.bradytx.us/956/Richards-Park (camping fees effective October 1, 2025, Section 1.10.001, Ordinance 1109: 'RV Spaces (maximum 10 days - maximum of 20 days annually) $25 per day'), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: From the park's own site (read 2026-10-13): RV sites are $50 a day, all inclusive, or $475 to $500 a month with $100 of electric included; pets in RV sites pay a pet fee.  The park books through ParkWithUs; its Campspot listing has shown it closed since January 2022.

source: https://beblessedrvpark.godaddysites.com/ ('Daily RV rates all inclusive $50.00'; 'Monthly $475.00-$500 ($100 electric included **overage will be charged)'; 'Pets allowed in RV spots only (pet fee)'; its 'Book NOW' buttons open https://parkwith.us/camps/be-blessed-rv-park), read 2026-10-13; https://parkwith.us/camps/be-blessed-rv-park (RV Site and Cabin offered for booking), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/book/beblessedrvpark (the site's 'RESERVE NOW' link: no site types, and the park record shows it closed from 2022-01-01 on), read 2026-10-13
